nodes.name: 20260813000004_go_classes_coa_topic_test_photos.sql
nodes.summary: Attaches answer-free question crops and full attempt-result screenshots to the first GO Classes COA topic-test records. It updates exactly fifteen PYQ attempt snapshots and fifteen journal questions for the target learner, failing atomically when the expected coverage is not met.
nodes.languageNotes: PostgreSQL anonymous migration block temporarily relaxes the immutable-attempt trigger, enriches JSONB snapshots idempotently, and verifies affected-row counts.

nodes.name: 20260813000005_go_classes_coa_topic_test_2_photos.sql
nodes.summary: Attaches question crops and learner-result screenshots to the second GO Classes COA topic-test attempt and journal records. It idempotently enriches fifteen immutable attempt snapshots and fifteen matching questions, enforcing complete migration coverage through row-count checks.
